Automatic price check
SerpApi · %1$s
Not set up: check market prices without screenshots

Checks a diecast\'s market price without screenshots. SerpApi searches Google Shopping in Indonesia for it, your AI picks the listings that are the same diecast, and the app works out the median as it does with screenshots.
It needs a free SerpApi account: 250 searches a month and 50 an hour. Each check uses one; the same search again within an hour is free.
Only the search keywords and your key go to SerpApi, never photos. The key stays on this phone and isn\'t in backups.
